attr_why_cooking: Cooking trains fine motor skills (cutting, stirring), focus on the steps and planning a healthy meal.
attr_why_circus: Circus trains movement and balance (motor skills) and the patience to try again after a mistake.
attr_why_meditation: Meditation trains attention and calmly handling feelings and stress.
attr_why_party: Party games train talking with others, teamwork and quick ideas.
attr_why_classroom: Classroom games train understanding the lesson and planning how to solve a task.
attr_why_reflection: Reflection trains naming your feelings and thoughts and focusing on what happened.
attr_why_online: Online games train clear communication through a screen and using digital tools safely.
